name: k2so-rats-fixes
title: K2SO Rat's Fixes
author: deadrat22
description: A collection of fixes for Krastorio 2 + Spaced Out (K2SO). Fixes the biomass pipeline stall (crafted biomass and fertilizer spawn fresh), keeps asteroids kr-radioactive immune (configurable; auto 50% with eRisel-k2-arsenal), makes maraxsis read the intended sand item, applies K2SO's >24-pack lab icon layout, breaks two-item spoil cycles from item migration fixes, makes the advanced centrifuge recipe consume atan-atom-forges, and lets the intergalactic transceiver be built on Cerys. Without the K2SO stack installed this mod does nothing.
